integrity: The symbolic parity-and-bridge proof is self-contained; the verifier independently checks domination and perfect matching on finite instances. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the two-clique, bridge-length-one dumbbell family with integers \(r,s\ge2\); other graph families also called dumbbells are outside scope.
The accessible 2016 paired-domination-polynomial artifact is a one-page conference item and does not disclose its full family list.
Finite enumeration through order 12 is only a consistency check and is not used as an infinite proof.
title: Paired-domination polynomial of dumbbell graphs
